subject: SCCs module selection — operational plan & evidence checklist
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Eve Thompson <eve.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCCs module question and evidence request for EU->UK transfers

Hi Priyom,

Quick question from Acme legal as we're progressing the DPA: for transfers between our EU controllers and Redwood's UK processing footprint, which SCCs module do you intend to execute (Module 2 vs Module 3) and will you be adopting the UK Addendum? Our privacy team needs:

- a short rationale for the chosen module,
- versioned SCCs text (or DocuSign link) for signature, and
- a list of evidence items we can share with our security reviewers (SOC 2, encryption description, subprocessors, retention timeline).

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday? We have a vendor security review on Friday.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Cole
Head of Legal Operations — Acme Health
ethan.cole@acmehealth.com
+44 20 7123 4567

[Attachment: vendor-questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCCs module question and evidence request for EU->UK transfers

Ethan — thanks for the clear ask and the deadline. Short answer up front: we recommend executing the EU Commission SCCs using Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) for the controller-to-processor flows in your DPA, and for transfers touching the UK we will apply the UK Addendum to those SCCs rather than a separate Module 1/3 approach.

Rationale (high-level):
- Module 2 best matches the Acme -> Redwood controller-to-processor relationship reflected in the DPA.
- The UK Addendum is the current operational path we use to cover cross-border flows into our UK infrastructure and is accepted by most customers in the healthcare vertical.

What we are sending now (attached / links):
1) sccs-module-matrix.xlsx — short mapping of flow types -> recommended module + fallback.
2) dpa-evidence-pack.pdf — includes latest SOC 2 summary, encryption at rest/in transit notes, retention defaults, and our subprocessors list snapshot.
3) DocuSign envelope (link below) with the SCCs + UK Addendum prefilled for signature.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: confirm module choice and circulate evidence pack (attached).
- Tue: your legal signs SCCs via DocuSign; procurement to route as needed.
- Wed-Fri: security team call if they want a 30-min walkthrough of controls.

DocuSign (preview): https://redwood.app/docusign/abc123
Drive (evidence): https://drive.redwood.com/share/1a2b3c/sccs-evidence

Attachments: sccs-module-matrix.xlsx, dpa-evidence-pack.pdf

If you prefer a short call (15–20m) to walk through the evidence list, Ben (sales) and Monica (CS) are copied and can join.

Thanks — happy to iterate if your legal team has a different preference.

Best,
Priyom Das
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Subject: Internal: Acme SCCs — routing & evidence checklist

Priyom / Ben —

Thanks for the draft reply; I made a couple of small edits in the attached matrix. A few operational asks before we hit send to Acme (so procurement and legal know where to route signatures):

- Procurement vs Legal routing: do we want Acme procurement to sign the DPA + SCCs, or should legal sign the SCCs and procurement handle the commercial schedule separately? My recommendation: legal signs SCCs/UK Addendum; procurement handles ordering. That keeps the legal record cleaner.

- Evidence items the security reviewers will expect (please confirm we can include these in the pack):
  - SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) — provide a summary and cert date
  - Encryption: short note on KMS + TLS + key rotation cadence
  - Subprocessors: include current list and a process note for notification of changes
  - Data retention defaults and deletion process (30/90/365 buckets)

- Can we commit to providing the subprocessors list as a PDF snapshot today and the full CSV via SFTP by EOD Tue?

Ben — can you confirm procurement preference and whether you want the DocuSign envelope sent to procurement@acmehealth.com or legal@acmehealth.com?

If we want to add any contractual exceptions (e.g., data export exceptions for specific EU regions), flag it now.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Legal — Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
